newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian Alkimia to distribute dividends.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian Alkimia to distribute dividends.

text.p: Chemicals firm Alkimia on Monday said it will distribute a 3.445 dinars dividend and super dividend per nominal 10 dinar share, lower than a 4.035 dinars distributed last year.
The firm's results showed a 7.629 million dinar net profit in 1996, up from a revised 7.076 million dinars in 1995.
Alkimia, which manufactures and trades chemical inputs for detergents, has a capital of 17.096 million dinars.
It is listed at the Tunis Stock Exchange where its share was priced on Monday at 51 dinars. ($=1.1 dinar)
